t: Understanding Gwei: Key to Ethereum Transactions
s: November 19, 2025 - Gwei is a denomination of the cryptocurrency ether (ETH), used on the Ethereum network to buy and sell goods and services. A gwei is one-billionth of one ETH. Gwei is the most commonly used ether unit. Ethereum transaction fees, known as gas fees, are priced in gwei so that they is easier to understand.
